# mergewf_scim_group (Resource)

Provisions a SCIM group using the separate SCIM token. Updates use PUT replacement semantics. Do not manage the same object from an identity provider and Terraform. Import using the SCIM ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mergewf_scim_group" "example" {
  display_name = "Engineering"
  external_id  = "engineering"
  members      = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) API field `displayName`.

### Optional

- `external_id` (String) API field `externalId`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection.
- `members` (Attributes List) API field `members`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identity. See the resource description for its import format.
- `result_json` (String) Complete API response encoded as JSON. Use jsondecode to access additional response fields. Stored in Terraform state.

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Required:

- `value` (String) value.

Optional:

- `display` (String) display.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergewf_scim_group.example RESOURCE_ID
```
